prefix_policy.historical_request_reuse: none: native recomputes each request, vLLM endpoint generates fresh cache salt

graph_policy: native optional graphs enabled; vLLM default compile/graph
candidate_must_win: All predefined cells: lower pooled P50/P95, higher QPS; no failed or skipped requests. Screen cannot accept a change.

trace_design.scope: Diagnostic timing only, not a production fix
trace_design.clock: same-host time.time_ns / Rust SystemTime UNIX ns; GPU completion boundary is scheduler update_from_output (pooling result ready), not worker enqueue return
trace_design.request_identity: x-jev-trace-id header; model input unchanged; candidate IDs mapped to outer request; batch membership retained
trace_design.control: same bench.py plus headers and timestamps; frozen binaries vs traced binaries; same GPU sequential; schema validated responses
trace_design.gpu_kernel_caveat: Worker callback and result-ready intervals include CPU/runtime and device work; not labelled pure kernel time
